evidence_scope.exact: Conditional handwritten bounds; finite exact checks are separate.
evidence_scope.execution: Independent old/new fixed-order separate-RNE affine executions with actual endpoint differences.
evidence_scope.domains: Point, complete registered finite envelope and analytic box claims retain separate coverage/totality premises.
evidence_scope.receipts: Read-only numeric budget evidence; no BIT/ALG_AND_BIT or live commit authority.
evidence_scope.B1: Frozen recorded endpoints receive new B2 analysis; earlier optimizer experiments are not rerun.
evidence_scope.backends: Software BF16 and audited local scalar CPU FP32 only.
evidence_scope.excluded: GPU, native BF16, general concurrency, arbitrary compiler changes, general learning and later-stage composition.
